documentationShelf.title: Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 — India Code

claims.text: The official India Code result for the Karnataka Marriages (Registration and Miscellaneous Provisions) Act, 1976 describes it as an Act providing uniform law for registration of marriages in Karnataka and states its purpose includes compulsory registration of marriages.
claims.notes: The indexed official PDF endpoint was unavailable when opened; verify current consolidated text before relying on section-level details.

claims.text: The Karnataka Stamps and Registration Department's 2023–24 annual report states that the department registers marriages under the Hindu Marriage Act and the Special Marriage Act, and that Kaveri-2.0 was implemented across the department's sub-registrar offices.
claims.notes: Annual report is official but not a live application result.

claims.text: Section 8 of the Hindu Marriage Act provides for entering particulars of a Hindu marriage in a Hindu Marriage Register under prescribed state rules and conditions; a state may make such entry compulsory in all or specified cases.
claims.jurisdiction: India; Karnataka implementation by state rules
claims.notes: The Act does not provide the current Karnataka form, fee, document list or portal behavior.

claims.text: Under section 5 of the Special Marriage Act, parties intending solemnization give written notice to the Marriage Officer of the district where at least one party has resided for at least thirty days immediately before the notice; sections 6–7 provide for entry/publication and objections.
claims.jurisdiction: India; Karnataka implementation by Marriage Officer/SRO
claims.notes: Statutory route; no Bengaluru office or notice was selected.

claims.text: The Special Marriage Act provides statutory declaration/solemnization and certificate steps after the notice/objection stage, and a separate chapter for registration of marriages celebrated in other forms.
claims.jurisdiction: India; Karnataka implementation by Marriage Officer/SRO
claims.notes: No statutory declaration, witness appearance or certificate was attempted.

claims.text: Kaveri 2.0 is the official public entry point identified by the Registration Department's current digital program; this pass records the landing URL only and does not establish that a particular Bengaluru SRO, marriage category or certificate action is available without login.
claims.notes: No login, OTP, form, upload, payment, appointment or submission.

claims.text: No reviewed official public source establishes the current Bengaluru SRO for a supplied couple, current fee, document/original checklist, appointment availability, processing time, objection outcome or certificate issuance.
claims.notes: No personal data or case action was performed.
